rules.scope: Secondary measurements; no checkpoint, loss or task selection from CKA.
rules.subset: First 128 saved test rows of each length, identical for every condition and initialization.
rules.feature: Target and frozen inverse-input teacher final_norm at task-free ONE_END.
rules.aggregation: Compute within each length and average the five lengths equally.
rules.matched_control: Keep answer strata with at least three rows; cyclic shift each stratum by one row, preserving length and true target answer. Use identical kept rows in correct and wrong scores.
rules.answer_residual: Subtract each true-answer stratum mean from both hidden matrices on the same kept rows. This removes linear answer means, not all output information.
rules.initialization: Replay the exact stored target initialization for each replicate, with the same teacher and test subset.
